purpose: Pin the external build-context artifact required by infra/shanxi_runner/Dockerfile for the reproduced cb16-runner-r11 image.

required_build_context_files.verification_rule: Required build-context binary must exist, be 51102256 bytes and have the pinned SHA256 before docker build is allowed.

image_reconstruction.known_limitation: The original Dockerfile, build context, builder version and build metadata are unavailable. A rebuild reproduces the declared runtime contract, not necessarily the same image ID.
